Pandora Raven - Album 5.5: The Raven's Light

Road to Redemption

"To the weak, the meager, the ordinary... I will come."

[Verse 1 - piano alone, stripped, she’s standing in a field with no one] I am standing in a field with no one watching No followers, no banners, no one’s name No order at my back, no voice to witness Just the weight of who I was and what I’ll claim

I’ve heard about the oaths that armies take The raised hand, the promise, the drawn blade But I have nothing like that — just this road And everything I owe for what I’ve made

[Pre-Chorus - the call] But the weak don’t have an army either The broken don’t announce when they fall The ordinary never make the record And the forgotten — they get no one at all

[Chorus - the oath, full and clear] So I swear it on this road To the ones who have no voice To the weak, the meager, the ordinary The forgotten and the broken — by choice I will come Even if it costs me everything I have Even if it costs me this life I will come This is my road to redemption And I walk it alone tonight

[Verse 2 - the cost, clear-eyed] I know what oaths like this have cost before I’ve seen the ones who swore and didn’t come back I know the dark that’s coming — I was part of it I know exactly how the endings crack

But there’s no one standing here to stop me No council and no crown to grant me leave I am the only witness to this moment And I am enough — I have to believe

[Pre-Chorus 2] I have no order I have no crimson banner No one standing at my right But I have this road And whatever’s left of me And I swear it on the east and on the light

[Chorus] So I swear it on this road To the ones who have no voice To the weak, the meager, the ordinary The forgotten and the broken — by choice I will come Even if it costs me everything I have Even if it costs me this life I will come This is my road to redemption And I walk it alone tonight

[Bridge - the parallel, the solitude accepted] Somewhere out there Someone raises a banner Swears it in red before a gathered crowd Somewhere there’s an order Somewhere there’s an army Somewhere they can say the vow out loud

I have none of that And I will never have it This is what I chose when the light came through One woman, one road, one reckoning Becoming something new

[Final Chorus - sealed] I swear it on this road To the ones who have no voice To the weak, the meager, the ordinary The forgotten and the broken — my choice I will come Even if it costs me everything I have Even if it costs me this life I will come This is my road to redemption And I walk it — I walk it —

Alone

[Outro - solo piano, she keeps walking] No witness No banner No crown Just the road And the promise And the dawn
